What the item could not say, and what is new this wake: its harness exercises household SUGAR and grams-mode SALT but never household SALT, so the class of bug the 09-16 fix removed from sugar still lives in salt. docs/works/ors.html prints the fixed string '1/2 level teaspoon (approx 2.6 g)' for every saltTsp in [0.35,0.75) - i.e. every volume from 700 mL to under 1500 mL - so 750 mL gets 2.6 g where the page's own 2.6 g/L ratio wants 1.95 g (+33% salt) and 1250 mL gets 2.6 g where it wants 3.25 g (-20%). Same shape as the hardcoded 8.3 g sugar branch, in the ingredient where an error is hyponatraemia rather than worse diarrhoea.
